name: Plotline
summary: A real-estate CRM with a live listings map, homes for sale and rent, a deals board and live chat
about: An eight-page CRM for an estate agency, property manager or rental team, in slate and sea-teal. A drawn city map drops a pin for every listing and ripples when a new inquiry arrives. Manage listings for sale and rent with drawn property art, drag deals from inquiry to closed, track leads and viewings, chat live with clients and share listings into the chat, and see each agent's fees.
how: Open a page from the top bar (the menu button on a phone).
On Overview, watch pins drop onto the map; filter it by sale, rent or type, hover a pin for the price and click it to open the listing. The activity feed and ripples update live.
On Listings, search, filter by sale or rent, type and area, sort by price or views, then open a listing to save it, edit it or book a viewing.
On Deals, drag a card to the next stage (or focus it and press M); closing a deal marks the listing sold or let and adds the fee.
On Chat, pick a client, send a message and watch them type back; share a listing card or book a viewing from the chat.
Viewings lists what is coming up; mark one done to move its deal to Offer. Agents shows fees earned and in the pipeline.
